title: thymus loevyanus var. kosteleckyanus
intro: Thymus loevyanus var. kosteleckyanus, commonly known as Kotschy's thyme, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is known for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Kotschy's thyme include its antiseptic and expectorant properties, which can aid in the relief of coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, specifically thymol and carvacrol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
